recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit current ClinicalImpression source solely for this DSTU2 QA warning; future ordering work should be evaluated against the current active build scope and current resource model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 correction for a QA warning that ClinicalImpression elements were out of FiveWs order. The requested order was identifier, status, code, subject, effective[x], date, assessor, problem rather than identifier, status, code, subject, assessor, date, effective[x], problem.
initial_application: Commit e73353ab39a4227a35c7ec0fe8d20c75161c7064 on 2017-01-24 explicitly referenced #12688 and edited the DSTU2-era ClinicalImpression spreadsheet sources, moving effective[x] before date and assessor after date.
additional_context: The old spreadsheet source has since been refactored away from the current retained XML source. source/fhir.ini has no active [resources] entry for clinicalimpression, and the current structuredefinition-ClinicalImpression.xml orders effective[x] before date in the analogous area after later resource-model changes such as assessor becoming performer. Community searches found only tracker/commit bot notifications and no conflicting Patient Care minutes or Zulip rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is needed because the historical issue was applied and the current checkout does not expose the original ordering defect in an active ClinicalImpression build source.
